Hi Oliver — thanks, happy to coordinate. Quick clarification: when you say 10:00, do you mean 10:00 CET (Prague local) or 10:00 in another zone? We want to avoid any DST ambiguity. A couple of options that work for us: 

- Friday 3/20 at 16:00 CET (UTC+1) — that is 11:00 EDT (UTC-4) / 08:00 PDT (UTC-7) / 20:30 IST (UTC+5:30)
- Tue 3/16 at 10:00 CET (UTC+1) — that is 05:00 EDT / 02:00 PDT (early for our US team)

Important note on DST: US daylight saving time started on 2026-03-08, so when we quote PT/ET for dates after Mar 8 we mean PDT (UTC-7) and EDT (UTC-4). Europe switches later in March, so CET (UTC+1) is still standard on March 16–20.

If 16:00 CET on 3/20 works for you, we'll send an invite labeled explicitly with all timezones above ("16:00 CET / 11:00 EDT / 08:00 PDT / 20:30 IST") so calendar clients show the right local time. Dylan, can you draft the invite once Oliver confirms?

Best,
Marissa Cole
